binarize_text_to_ids: binarize a text file into token IDs using a dictionary and consumer callback
binarize_alignments: binarize an alignment file by parsing each line with an alignment parser and consuming IDs
find_offsets: find byte offsets for splitting a text file into equal-sized chunks for parallel processing
safe_readline: read a line from a file safely by recovering from Unicode decode errors
binarize_already_numberized: binarize a pre-numberized file of integer token IDs with optional EOS and reverse order
